intro_html: Turns a process your team runs the same way every time — onboarding a client, launching a website, closing out an offboarding — into a reusable checklist you attach to any task, so no important step ever gets missed, no matter who's running the work.

features.title: Reusable Templates
features.desc: Build a step-by-step checklist once, then attach it to any project task.

features.title: Independent Per-Task Copies
features.desc: Each task gets its own copy — freely add, remove, rename, or reorder steps without ever touching the original template.

features.title: One-Click Step Actions
features.desc: Start, Done, and Cancel actions with color-coded rows make status obvious at a glance.

features.title: Safe Checklist Switching
features.desc: Replacing an in-progress checklist shows a warning first, so you never lose recorded progress by accident.

features.title: Smart Progress Tracking
features.desc: Cancelled steps are excluded from the calculation, so an irrelevant step can never hold you below 100%.

features.title: Automatic Start/End Dates
features.desc: The task's dates stamp themselves as work happens — no manual entry, ever.

features.title: Manager-Curated Library
features.desc: Managers maintain the checklist library; everyone on the team can pick from it when working on a task.

features.title: Ready-to-Use Examples
features.desc: Ships with three example checklists — Client Onboarding, Website Launch, Employee Offboarding — so you can see it working right away.

limitations: No per-step assignment — the task's existing assignee owns all steps.
No email notifications or reminders on step changes.
Checklist templates aren't isolated per company.
Editing a template later doesn't retroactively change tasks that already applied it.
No dashboards/reports beyond the on-task and list-view progress bars.
